'''Tiger Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2sYGqrY Tiger Gas Pipeline,] A Barrel Full, accessed September 2017</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Carthage, Texas, to Delhi, Louisiana.

|lines=32.157352, -94.338391:32.457284, -91.493065|center=32.522186, -92.734563|width=400|height=300|type=normal|zoom=6}}

=== ETC Tiger Pipeline (Louisiana) Expansion ===
Tiger Gas Pipeline submitted for approval to the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission in June 2010 and was authorized in February 2011.<ref name=":1" /> The construction of the expansion project was completed on 19 July, 2011 and began operation since.<ref name="eia" />

==Background==
The Tiger Gas Pipeline transports natural gas from Haynesville Shale play in East Texas to Louisiana, US. The pipeline applied for authorization for construction from U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on 31 August, 2009.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://casetext.com/federal-register/etc-tiger-pipeline-llc-notice-of-application|title=ETC Tiger Pipeline, LLC; Notice of Application, 74 Fed. Reg. 47934 {{!}} Casetext|website=casetext.com|language=en|access-date=2023-08-30}}</ref> FERC issued a favorable environmental assessment for the project in January 2010.<ref name=":0" /> Construction of the pipeline began in June 2010 and was completed and became operational in December 2010.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbons-technology.com/projects/etctigerpipelineproj/|title=ETC Tiger Pipeline Project|last=|first=|date=|website=Hydrocarbons Technology|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=30 August, 2023}}</ref>

Tiger Gas Pipeline is operated by ETC Tiger Pipeline, LLC, a subsidiary of Energy Transfer Partners L.P.<ref>[http://ir.energytransfer.com/phoenix.zhtml?c=106094&p=irol-newsArticle&ID=1258504 Energy Transfer Partners Announces Open Season for the Tiger Pipeline Project Pipeline to Provide Takeaway Capacity from the East Texas Carthage Hub Area and the Haynesville Shale Play], Energy Transfer Press Release, Feb. 20, 2009</ref>
